name: tagged-desktop
description: Tagged in its own window: the Updraft (Mocha) look with Window transparency, and automatic updates from tagged-releases.
author: Wyatt Taylor

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Tagged for Windows.

**Download:** the Tagged-Setup .exe file below, under Assets.

**First time you open it:** Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the app isn't signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. You only need to do this once; updates install by themselves after that.

Tagged is private: only invited accounts can sign in.
